config.script:
username=self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	new_function_group_name=self.getSibling("TextField").props.text
	function_group_id=self.view.params.data.function_group_id
	data=self.view.params.data
	
	##edit group name
	params={"function_group_name":new_function_group_name,
			"function_group_id":function_group_id}
	system.db.execUpdate("API/Equipment_Manager/Function_Group/Update_Group_Name", params)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("tablerefresh")
	
	##logEvent
	logparams={"username":username,
		   "event_type":"Edit",
		   "before_change":str(data),
		   "after_change":str(params),
		   "description":"Edit Function Group Name"}
	API.Functions.log_activity(logparams)

import time
	username=self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	data_selection=self.parent.parent.getChild("Functions List").getChild("Table").props.selection.data
	function_group_id=self.view.params.data.function_group_id
	current_functions=self.parent.parent.getChild("Group Function List").getChild("Table").props.data
	function_group_name=self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Group Name").getChild("Entry").getChild("TextField").props.text
	
	if len(data_selection)!=0:
		
		for function in data_selection:
			params={"function_group_id":function_group_id,
					"function_id":function['function_id']}
			system.db.execUpdate("API/Equipment_Manager/Function_Group/Insert_Function_Relationship", params)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage("tablerefresh")
		
		time.sleep(.1)
		updated_functions=self.parent.parent.getChild("Group Function List").getChild("Table").props.data
		##logEvent
		logparams={"username":username,
			   "event_type":"Edit",
			   "before_change":str(current_functions)[16:],
			   "after_change":str(updated_functions)[16:],
			   "description":"Edit: Added function(s) to Function Group {0}".format(function_group_name)}
		API.Functions.log_activity(logparams)

import time
	function_group_name=self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Group Name").getChild("Entry").getChild("TextField").props.text
	username=self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	data_selection=self.parent.parent.getChild("Group Function List").getChild("Table").props.selection.data
	function_group_id=self.view.params.data.function_group_id
	current_functions=self.parent.parent.getChild("Group Function List").getChild("Table").props.data
	
	if len(data_selection)!=0:
		
		for function in data_selection:
			params={"function_group_id":function_group_id,
					"function_id":function['function_id']}
			system.db.execUpdate("API/Equipment_Manager/Function_Group/Delete_Function_From_Function_Group", params)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage("tablerefresh")
		
		time.sleep(.1)
		updated_functions=self.parent.parent.getChild("Group Function List").getChild("Table").props.data
		##logEvent
		logparams={"username":username,
			   "event_type":"Edit",
			   "before_change":str(current_functions)[16:],
			   "after_change":str(updated_functions)[16:],
			   "description":"Edit: Removed function(s) from Function Group {0}".format(function_group_name)}
		API.Functions.log_activity(logparams)
